arxiv-2110-06531.title: Generation of Bell and GHZ states from a hybrid qubit-photon-magnon system
arxiv-2110-06531.creator: Shi-fan Qi, Jun Jing
arxiv-2110-06531.description: Abstract We propose a level-resolved protocol in a hybrid architecture for connecting a superconducting qubit and a magnon mode contained within a microwave cavity (resonator) to generate the local and global entangled states, enabling a wide range of applications in quantum communication, quantum metrology, and quantum information processing.

arxiv-2205-06967.title: On LGRB progenitors: an approach from thermally-produced neutrinos
arxiv-2205-06967.creator: G. Morales, N. Fraija
arxiv-2205-06967.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by G. Morales, N. Fraija. Gamma-ray bursts (GRB) are the most intense electromagnetic (EM) sources in the Universe. Long GRB (LGRB) correspond to those events with a typical prompt emission of more than a few seconds. It is generally assumed that they are originated after an implosion of a very massive star within a central compact object engine that can be either a black hole (BH) or a rapidly-spinning highly-magnetized neutron star (NS).

arxiv-2209-13929.title: Attention Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv-2209-13929.creator: Man Yao, Guangshe Zhao, Hengyu Zhang, Yifan Hu, Lei Deng, Yonghong Tian, Bo Xu, Guoqi Li
arxiv-2209-13929.description: Abstract Benefiting from the event-driven nature and sparse spiking communication of the brain, spiking neural networks (SNNs) are becoming a promising energy-efficient alternative to traditional artificial neural networks (ANNs). However, the performance gap between SNNs and ANNs has been a significant hindrance to deploying SNNs ubiquitously for a very long period of time.

arxiv-2307-08720.title: ivrit.ai: A Comprehensive Dataset of Hebrew Speech for AI Research and Development
arxiv-2307-08720.creator: Yanir Marmor, Kinneret Misgav, Yair Lifshitz
arxiv-2307-08720.description: Abstract We introduce ivrit.ai , a comprehensive Hebrew speech dataset, addressing the distinct lack of extensive, high-quality resources for advancing Automated Speech Recognition (ASR) technology in Hebrew. With over 3,300 speech hours and a over a thousand diverse speakers, ivrit.ai offers a substantial compilation of Hebrew speech across various contexts.

arxiv-2309-07420.title: A new break near 10 TeV in the energy spectrum of protons according to data from space-based instruments:
arxiv-2309-07420.creator: astrophysical interpretation
arxiv-2309-07420.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by astrophysical interpretation. 1
Introduction

The most studied topics in high-energy astrophysics is the origin of Galactic cosmic rays. It is clear that in order to construct a theory of the origin of cosmic rays, it is necessary to solve two fundamental problems, the combined results of which should give a physical explanation of the observed spectra: a model of particle acceleration in sources and a model for transport of these particles from their sources to the Earth in a galactic turbulent (fractal type) medium.

arxiv-2309-14086.title: A selection of PID type controller settings via LQR approach for two-wheeled balancing robot
arxiv-2309-14086.creator: Krzysztof Laddach, Mateusz Czyżniewski, Rafał Łangowski
arxiv-2309-14086.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Krzysztof Laddach, Mateusz Czyżniewski, Rafał Łangowski. The problem of PID type controller tuning has been addressed in this paper. In particular, a method of selection of PD settings based on the solution of linear–quadratic optimisation problem using the energy criterion has been investigated. Thus, the possibility of transforming optimal settings of the linear–quadratic regulator into the settings of the controller in the classical control system has been given. The presented methodology has been used during synthesis of control system for a two–wheeled balancing robot.

arxiv-2310-05947.title: Robust and Efficient Interference Neural Networks for Defending Against Adversarial Attacks in ImageNet
arxiv-2310-05947.creator: Yunuo Xiong, Shujuan Liu, Hongwei Xiong
arxiv-2310-05947.description: Abstract The existence of adversarial images has seriously affected the task of image recognition and practical application of deep learning, it is also a key scientific problem that deep learning urgently needs to solve. By far the most effective approach is to train the neural network with a large number of adversarial examples.

arxiv-2502-13217.title: Hunting for heavy Z ′ Z^{\prime} with IceCube neutrinos and gravitational waves
arxiv-2502-13217.creator: Basabendu Barman, Arindam Das, Suruj Jyoti Das, Marco Merchand
arxiv-2502-13217.description: Abstract In the minimal gauged B − - L extension of the Standard Model, we demonstrate that PeV-scale dark matter (DM) and the baryon asymmetry of the Universe (BAU) can be simultaneously explained through the three right-handed neutrinos (RHNs) present in the theory.

arxiv-2508-11345.title: Conformal Prediction Meets Long-tail Classification
arxiv-2508-11345.creator: Shuqi Liu, Jianguo Huang, Luke Ong
arxiv-2508-11345.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Shuqi Liu, Jianguo Huang, Luke Ong. Conformal Prediction (CP) is a popular method for uncertainty quantification that converts a pretrained model’s point prediction into a prediction set, with the set size reflecting the model’s confidence. Although existing CP methods are guaranteed to achieve marginal coverage, they often exhibit imbalanced coverage across classes under long-tail label distributions, tending to over cover the head classes at the expense of under covering the remaining tail classes.

arxiv-2509-01510.title: Dirac states from the ’t Hooft model
arxiv-2509-01510.creator: Paul Hoyer
arxiv-2509-01510.description: Abstract The dynamics of a light fermion bound to a heavy one is expected to be described by the Dirac equation with an external potential. The potential breaks translation invariance, whereas the bound state momentum is well defined. Boosting the bound state determines the frame dependence of the light fermion dynamics.

arxiv-2510-24625.title: Dijets with large rapidity separation at the next-to-leading BFKL for search of large extra dimension gravity at colliders
arxiv-2510-24625.creator: Anatolii Iu. Egorov, Victor T. Kim, Viktor A. Murzin, Vadim A. Oreshkin
arxiv-2510-24625.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anatolii Iu. Egorov, Victor T. Kim, Viktor A. Murzin, Vadim A. Oreshkin. Search for the gravity with large extra dimensions at collider energies is considered in the trans-Planckian eikonal regime, i. e., when s ^ ≫ M D ≫ − t ^ \mbox{$\sqrt{\hat{s}}$}\gg\mbox{$M_{D}$}\gg\sqrt{-\mbox{$\hat{t}$}} . Here s ^ \hat{s} and t ^ \hat{t} are the Mandelstam variables of colliding parton-parton system and M D M_{D} is the Planck mass scale in the space-time with compactified n D n_{D} extra dimensions.

arxiv-2601-01104.title: Quantum optimisation applied to the Quadratic Assignment Problem
arxiv-2601-01104.creator: Andrew Freeland, Jingbo Wang
arxiv-2601-01104.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Andrew Freeland, Jingbo Wang. This paper investigates the performance of the emerging non-variational Quantum Walk-based Optimisation Algorithm (NV-QWOA) 50 ; 49 ; 47 for solving small instances of the Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP). NV-QWOA is benchmarked against classical heuristics, namely the Max-Min Ant System (MMAS) 21 and Greedy Local Search (GLS) 34 ; 47 , as well as Grover’s quantum search algorithm 18 , which serves as a quantum baseline.

arxiv-2601-20800.title: Conditional PED-ANOVA: Hyperparameter Importance in Hierarchical & Dynamic Search Spaces DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: Make sure to enter the correct conference title from your rights confirmation email; June 03–05, 2018; Woodstock, NY ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computing methodologies
arxiv-2601-20800.creator: Kaito Baba, Yoshihiko Ozaki, Shuhei Watanabe
arxiv-2601-20800.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Kaito Baba, Yoshihiko Ozaki, Shuhei Watanabe. We propose conditional PED-ANOVA (condPED-ANOVA) , a principled framework for estimating hyperparameter importance (HPI) in conditional search spaces, where the presence or domain of a hyperparameter can depend on other hyperparameters. Although the original PED-ANOVA provides a fast and efficient way to estimate HPI within the top-performing regions of the search space, it assumes a fixed, unconditional search space and therefore cannot properly handle conditional hyperparameters.

pmc-11311748.title: Exploration of Therapeutic Strategies of Herbal Prescriptions for Carbuncle Treatment to Suggest Modern Approaches to Inflammatory Bowel Disease: Cluster and Network Analyses of the Book «Liu Juan Zi Gui Yi Fang»
pmc-11311748.creator: Dasol Park, Heonyoung Jeong, Jungtae Leem
pmc-11311748.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) treatments in East Asian traditional medicine (EATM) originate from principles for treating abscesses and carbuncles. pmc-11402239.title: A potential cause for extensive dieback of Acacia mearnsii plantation in highland districts of Awi zone, northwestern Ethiopia
pmc-11402239.creator: Mulugeta Tamer, Melkamu Kassaye, Tigest Molla, Kelelaw Kebede, Yehizbalem Azmeraw

We conducted this study in four districts that hold potential for A. mearnsii plantations.

pmc-11641272.title: Passive Smoking Is Associated with the Risk of Functional Bowel Disorders Among College Freshmen
pmc-11641272.creator: Jinlu Guo, Fan Du, Chaofan Duan, Can Chen, Jingze Yang, Xin Yang, Shi Liu, Tao Bai, Xiaohua Hou
pmc-11641272.description: Background: Functional bowel disorders (FBDs) have detrimental effects on young adults, but the risk factors were not fully explored. This study aimed to investigate the prevalence and potential risk factors of FBDs in college freshmen, including, in particular, the association between passive smoking and the risk and symptoms of FBDs.

pmc-11670207.title: Identification of key genes related to growth of largemouth bass (Micropterus salmoides) based on comprehensive transcriptome analysis
pmc-11670207.creator: Dayan Hu, Jieliang Jian, Jinpeng Zhang, Xiaojun Xu, Shu Wang, Cuiping Gong, Yuanqin Zhang, Pengcan Zhu, Zhimin Gu, Wenzhi Guan
pmc-11670207.description: IntroductionLargemouth bass is an economically important farmed freshwater fish species that has delicious meat, no intermuscular thorns, and rapid growth rates. However, the molecular regulatory mechanisms underlying the different growth and developmental stages of this fish have not been reported.

pmc-12680311.title: Food protein–induced enterocolitis syndrome: Disease burden for patients and families
pmc-12680311.creator: Bianca N Patel, Jonathan S Tam
pmc-12680311.description: Background:The impact of food protein–induced enterocolitis syndrome (FPIES) extends beyond the direct effects after consumption of an inciting food. Although elimination of the trigger food does alleviate the symptoms of FPIES, it does not address the burden of disease among patients and families living with FPIES.

pmc-13007021.title: Structure–Activity Relationships for 1,3-Dipolar Cycloaddition Reactions of Criegee Intermediates with Carbonyls
pmc-13007021.creator: Zachary A. Cornwell, Jonas J. Enders, Bridget Ferris, Craig Murray, Aaron W. Harrison
pmc-13007021.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Carbonyl oxides, or Criegee intermediates (CIs), are key species formed during the ozonolysis of alkenes and are an important atmospheric oxidant. However, direct measurements of CI gas-phase rate constants for many atmospherically relevant reactions are still unknown. Herein, we present various approaches for developing structure–activity relationships (SARs) to predict the reactivity of the simplest CI (formaldehyde oxide; CH2OO) with a range of carbonyls that are significant primary emission components as well as secondary products of hydrocarbon oxidation in the atmosphere.
